canonical_project: DC Alliance / Pacific Blockchain Tier III Palau Data Centre
notes: DC Alliance announced an MOU with Palau-based Pacific Blockchain Corporation to develop what it described as Palau's first Tier III data center. Public coverage does not disclose the facility site or MW capacity; assigned to Koror because Pacific Blockchain's publicly reported Palau presence/business registrations are in Koror and no other division-level location was found.
